_about: A Profile promotion's claimers with what each spent (Growth > Profile promotions Details). OF's /subscriptions/subscribers?filter[promoId] as the relay's link_metrics walks it. PII-free: synthetic ids, names, usernames, dates and amounts; only the shape is OF's.
_source: Live reads in the operator's logged-in OnlyFans tab (2026-10-18, .scratch/growth-todo/capture.md 0.1): GET /api2/v2/subscriptions/subscribers?limit=10&offset=0&format=infinite&filter[promoId]=<id>, {list, hasMore}; limit 20 returned the same rows. Promotion claimers carry the same subscribedOnData as trial claimers (subscribeAt ISO with +00:00, totalSumm = subscribesSumm + postsSumm + messagesSumm + streamsSumm + tipsSumm, in dollars). Nothing in subscribes[] names the promotion; only the filter and subscribeAt tie the fan to it. The third row has no subscribedOnData (the fallback: first-seen time, spend unknown). Rows trimmed to the fields read here.
